text: ok i cant add more than one mesh from another saved already. and after one is used i cant at any type of outliner
resolution: Fixed the shared Add Outliner failure after a saved-mesh import. The first append had converted its one neutral UV gutter texel into an occupied placeholder island; the next saved mesh or primitive therefore failed before geometry installation. The host now reuses that neutral texel for every un-atlased append in the same stale-layout session and invalidates it only when the atlas coordinate space is genuinely rebuilt. Added a repeated-preserving-append Zig regression and an import-capable part-operations replay. Verified 43/43 model-paint tests, 3/3 multipart residency tests, a ReleaseFast editor build, the exact bookshelf-import twice then cube sequence, and a stress replay with five bookshelf imports plus cube, cylinder, and sphere; all cart rows, face counts, and host ranges stayed ordered and exact.
